meta.title: Agent browser bridge
meta.description: Lets DeepSeek Harness drive a real browser through agent-browser, with two tools: `browser` runs one agent-browser command per call, and `browser_screenshot` returns the page or an element as an image. Target `bridge` (default) controls the everyday Chrome, Edge, or Brave you are already signed in to — the companion extension connects outward to a loopback Relay, so no browser launch flags are needed and your existing logins and tabs are reused. Target `headless` (or `headed`) launches an isolated agent-browser Chromium per conversation for project automation and tests: assertions, accessibility audits, Web Vitals, network capture, HAR, and visual diffs, without touching the user's browser. Also included: a `$` quick tab picker in the composer that inserts tab references carrying the CDP target id, a Browser status control in the composer dock and on the new-session screen (agent-browser version, relay endpoint, synced tabs, one-click extension download, and closing leftover isolated test browsers), and a bundled `browser-bridge` skill with the full workflow guide. Safety: webpage content is marked untrusted to mitigate prompt injection, the local CDP endpoint stays loopback-only, `readOnly` keeps the model on observation commands, JavaScript evaluation and credential commands are blocked against the real browser by default, and isolated browsers are closed when the plugin unloads. Requires the agent-browser CLI (npm i -g agent-browser && agent-browser install). Turning the plugin off removes both tools, hides the status control, and stops any Relay it started.
